# Sequences real modems sent when they called v90d (recordings of
# sync-build/live-050, made 2026-11-15 and -16; not in the repository), as
# tools/v90m-fields decodes them: the bits the library's answering side took
# for one sequence, the first of its kind in the call. Fields: recording,
# modem (conexant: Conexant CX93001 USB; usr5686: U.S. Robotics 5686, flash
# 5.4.62; usr1998: U.S. Robotics 56K of 1998, flash 5.1.4), sequence, seconds
# from the answer tone, number of bits, the bits in the order they were
# received. CM: its information octets (after the sync), LSB first.
# INFO*: the bits after the frame sync (information and CRC). The others:
# from the first bit of the frame sync. test/test_realcheck.c reads it.
# Recording options (v90m-fields): cxa -9 -u 33600; ab_cc_v90, v34a, x2r2,
# x2b -9 -u 32000; usr7, f1 -9.
